subject: Re: LaunchDarkly renewal — proposed commercial + SOW next steps
messages:
From: Sam Whitaker <sam@launchdarkly.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>; Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@launchdarkly.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LaunchDarkly renewal proposal (May 2026)

Hi Karthik & Monica,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per your ask, attached is a proposed renewal for LaunchDarkly to cover Redwood Inference through July 2027 (12-month option w/ early-pay incentive). High level:

- Product: Feature Flags + Experimentation Platform (Enterprise)
- Seats/Envs: 120 seats / 30 production flags holder / 8 environments
- Baseline list price: $225k/year
- Proposed: $180k/year (20% discount) for a 12-month term; 2.5% additional discount for an annual prepay
- SLA credit language: 15% credit for annualized downtime >0.25%

We included an updated SOW (SOW_RDW_Q3_2026_v2.docx) to reflect a small onboarding package for new platform governance and an audit of Active Flags. Also attached the PDF summary (LD_Renewal_Proposal_May2026.pdf).

Two items we flagged as you requested: audit logs retention (we can bump to 18 months for compliance) and a data-residency note (EU-only buckets available for any user data you route that way).

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal review on your end — pricing/finance + legal
2) If good, we can issue a DocuSign for signatures and finalize SOW

Happy to hop on a short call this week if you want to walk the line items.

Best,
Sam Whitaker
Enterprise Account Exec | LaunchDarkly
Attachments: LD_Renewal_Proposal_May2026.pdf; SOW_RDW_Q3_2026_v2.docx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Whitaker <sam@launchdarkly.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LaunchDarkly renewal proposal (May 2026)

Sam — thanks for sending. Quick notes after a first pass:

- Monica + I like the commitment to extended audit log retention (18 months) — critical for upcoming SOC readiness.
- Can you confirm the mechanism for flag-level exports? We use automated exports into our analytics cluster for experiment telemetry and need schema stability guarantees for 6 months after each change.
- On pricing: 20% is a good start but we were expecting a stronger rebate given our usage growth + multi-product commitment (we also use the Experimentation add-on).

Looping in Naomi on finance to confirm budgeting cadence and whether a prepay is feasible. Monica — can you weigh in on governance hours in the SOW?

If we can get to a 25% effective discount with the annual prepay and a tighter SLA credit (10% credit for downtime >0.2%), I think we can fast-track to signatures.

- Karthik
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Whitaker <sam@launchdarkly.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2026 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LaunchDarkly renewal proposal (May 2026)

Thanks Sam — quick clarifying items from product/gov side: 

- The SOW lists 20 governance hours for rollout best practices. We'd like that increased to 40 to cover our new model gating patterns and runbook updates.
- Please confirm the flag naming enforcement and a recommended lifecycle policy (we'll want an automation playbook).
- For experiments: can you commit to a weekly ingestion SLA for experiment events into our analytics export? 24-36 hours is what we currently see; tightening to 24 hours would be useful.

Naomi — do we have procurement windows this month? If prepay is required to hit the 2.5% extra discount, we need to flag cashflow impact.

Monica
Sr. PM, Product Experimentation
Redwood Inference
From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@launchdarkly.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Whitaker <sam@launchdarkly.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LaunchDarkly renewal proposal (May 2026)

Hi Monica & Karthik — thanks for the detailed feedback. Short answers: 

- Flag exports: we can provide a stable export schema and commit to notifying you 30 days before breaking schema changes. We will add a clause to the SOW.
- Governance hours: we can increase the package to 40 hours and include an automation playbook template; we'll mark that in SOW v3.
- Experiment event ingestion: we can commit to next-day exports (within 24 hours) for experiment events routed to your analytics cluster.
- SLA: we are comfortable adjusting the credit threshold to 0.2% annual downtime and 10% credit above that.
- Pricing: taking your ask for a stronger rebate back to the commercial team — prelim note: we can stretch to a 23% effective discount with annual prepay; an approval to 25% would need one more internal sign-off.

I've attached an annotated SOW with the governance hours noted (SOW_RDW_Q3_2026_v2.docx) and a revised pricing slide set is available on the link Sam shared.

Best,
Priya Rao
Enterprise Solutions Lead | LaunchDarkly
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Whitaker <sam@launchdarkly.com>; Priya Rao <priya.rao@launchdarkly.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LaunchDarkly renewal proposal (May 2026)

Sam/Priya — thanks, that addresses most of our asks. Internal decision path: Naomi confirmed we can do an annual prepay within our Q2 procurement window, and Monica is happy with the 40 governance hours and 24-hour ingestion SLA. Two final asks before procurement signs: 

1) Please add the schema-notice clause to the SOW (30-day notice for export/schema changes).
2) Add explicit language that audit logs retention will be 18 months for the account and that exports are accessible for our SOC audit team.

If you can update the SOW and recirculate, we'll get legal/procurement to triage and aim for DocuSign by end of week. Approving on commercial terms conditionally pending the SOW updates — Naomi, please proceed with PO generation once DocuSign is live.

Thanks — Karthik
Director, Platform Engineering | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: LD_Renewal_Proposal_May2026.pdf; SOW_RDW_Q3_2026_v2.docx
